The output type is now correct, but returned tensor is still empty. In the documentation I see that such a case (bfloat16 input) is supported so the output shouldn't be empty.

@Poiu19,
The input shape is `shape=(0,)` which is not able to fetch the data. Could you please find the gist of it [here](https://colab.research.google.com/gist/tilakrayal/9fa63ac931b6a3f76652dc2584cef9c5/untitled420.ipynb) and provide the input shape. @tilakrayal 

The input shape is not `shape=(0,)`. What you have indicated is the output shape, take a look at what is being printed:
```
    print("type:        ", output)
```
In fact, the input shape is `shape=(1, 56, 56, 1)` and in the test with `dtype=float32`, the output has the same shape as the input, while in the test with `dtype=bfloat16` the output is `shape=(0,)`

@sachinprasadhs,
I was able to get the `dtype:bfloat16` on tf-nightly. But I was not able to fetch the output data. Kindly find the gist of it [here](https://colab.research.google.com/gist/tilakrayal/4d3d1b8c9bbb8fc23e74b7dd4f4079f6/56680.ipynb).

Ugh, this is the same as #55738.  It should now throw an error with the latest nightly.

@penpornk what's the tag or contact for intel MKL?  This is because of the no-op registrations.  Intel needs to add proper kernels if they're going to be registering ops.
